name: BN Agrochem Limited
summary: BN Agrochem Limited operates in India's fast-moving consumer goods market, focusing on the production and sale of a diverse range of items. Its core business encompasses edible oils, oil seeds, and refined oils, as well as solvent extraction and the distribution of extracted oil-cakes. Founded in 1991, the company is headquartered in Gautam Buddha Nagar, India. It is currently known as BN Holdings Limited but is slated to officially become BN Agrochem Limited in August 2025.
